body.query: SELECT StudentID, Name, Email, Course, TotalFee, PaidAmount, TotalFee - PaidAmount AS Balance, CONVERT(varchar(10), DueDate, 23) AS DueDate, DATEDIFF(DAY, DueDate, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'India Standard Time' AS date)) AS DaysOverdue FROM dbo.Students WHERE PaidAmount < TotalFee AND DueDate < CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'India Standard Time' AS date) AND IsTestData = 0 AND (LastReminderSentAt IS NULL OR LastReminderSentAt < DATEADD(DAY, -3, SYSUTCDATETIME())) ORDER BY DueDate

body.Subject: Fee reminder: Rs. @{formatNumber(items('For_each_overdue_student')?['Balance'], 'N2', 'en-IN')} overdue
body.Body:
Dear @{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['Name']},

This is a reminder that your fee for @{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['Course']} is overdue.

  • Total fee: Rs. @{formatNumber(items('For_each_overdue_student')?['TotalFee'], 'N2', 'en-IN')}
  • Paid so far: Rs. @{formatNumber(items('For_each_overdue_student')?['PaidAmount'], 'N2', 'en-IN')}
  • Balance due: Rs. @{formatNumber(items('For_each_overdue_student')?['Balance'], 'N2', 'en-IN')}
  • Due date: @{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['DueDate']} (@{items('For_each_overdue_student')?['DaysOverdue']} days overdue)

Please clear your dues at the earliest. If you have already paid, please ignore this email.

Regards,
Accounts Office

body.query: UPDATE dbo.Students SET LastReminderSentAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE StudentID = @{int(items('For_each_overdue_student')?['StudentID'])}
